tools.name: check-package
tools.description: Checks whether a dependency (npm, PyPI, RubyGems or Packagist/Composer, or a GitHub Action used in a workflow) is on the DugganUSA malicious-package deny-list or has published advisories. Suited to a pre-install step in an agent or a CI pipeline, against slopsquatting and hijacked-package attacks.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check-repo" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, .npmrc). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Before you open or run a repository someone else sent you (a recruiter's coding test, a downloaded zip, a proof of concept), pass it the few files that matter a…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, enrich-ioc, correlate, stix-feed-summary, check-package, check-workflow, check-repo · Private data: search, enrich-ioc, correlate, stix-feed-summary, ai-model-price, check-package, check-workflow, check-repo · Public sink: search, enrich-ioc, kev-exploitation-stickiness · Destructive: check-workflow, check-repo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, enrich-ioc, correlate, stix-feed-summary, check-package, check-workflow, check-repo · Private data: search, enrich-ioc, correlate, stix-feed-summary, ai-model-price, check-package, check-workflow, check-repo · Public sink: search, enrich-ioc, kev-exploitation-stickiness · Destructive: check-workflow, check-repo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "correlate" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
